info.title: Chat API
info.description: REST API for the chat application. Provides endpoints for theme configuration, authentication, and management. All endpoints return appropriate HTTP status codes (200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 502, 503) with descriptive error messages.

tags.name: chat
tags.description: Chat completion proxy to DIAL Core

tags.name: rate
tags.description: Submit assistant message ratings to DIAL Core

tags.name: deployments
tags.description: List deployments available to the authenticated user

claims.description: Allowlisted claims keyed by claim name. A dot-notation rolesClaim (e.g. "realm_access.roles") is stored under one flat key equal to that literal string, never as a nested object.

isAdmin.description: Whether the user's roles claim intersects the provider's configured adminRoles

label.description: Visible label of the announcement call to action. Plain text; never interpreted as markup.

href.description: Absolute http(s) URL the announcement links to. Opened in a new tab with rel="noopener noreferrer". Entries carrying other schemes are dropped server-side.

title.description: Announcement heading. Plain text; never interpreted as markup. Entries without one are dropped server-side.

description.description: Supporting copy, sanitized to a safe HTML subset. Null when unset or when sanitization removes everything.

link.description: Optional call to action. Null when the announcement is informational only. An entry whose link is present but invalid is dropped entirely rather than returned without it.

title.description: The postMessage protocol namespace, NOT a display label. Every message exchanged with the iframe is prefixed "${title}/…", and the visualizer application must be constructed with this identical string as its appName. A mismatch is a silent failure — the iframe loads but never receives data.

description.description: Human-readable description of the visualizer. Accepted for schema parity; not consumed by the host UI.

icon.description: Icon URL or identifier for the visualizer. Accepted for schema parity; not consumed by the host UI.

contentType.description: MIME type(s) this entry matches. Accepts a comma-separated list of MIME types (e.g. "application/vnd.plotly.v1+json, application/vnd.vega.v5+json").

url.description: Absolute HTTP(S) URL of the visualizer iframe.

requestTimeout.description: Milliseconds to wait for a send() request response before rejecting. Defaults to 10000 when unset. Does not bound the initial READY_TO_INTERACT handshake.

width.description: Suggested initial width of the canvas panel in pixels.

height.description: Suggested initial height of the canvas panel in pixels.

mobileHeight.description: Suggested canvas panel height on mobile-sized screens in pixels.

passAuthInfo.description: Whether the host should pass auth info to the visualizer. Accepted for schema parity; auth forwarding is not yet wired.

passExplicitToken.description: Whether the host should pass an explicit access token. Accepted for schema parity; auth forwarding is not yet wired.

appVersion.description: Version string of the running chat application. Sourced from CHAT_VERSION; falls back to the application package.json version when that env var is unset or blank. Always a non-empty string.

asrModelId.description: Deployment ID of the ASR model. Null when ASR is not configured.

transcribeSizeLimitBytes.description: Maximum audio file size in bytes accepted by the transcription endpoint.

defaultDeploymentId.description: Operator-configured default deployment ID. Null when not configured.

dialCoreExternalUrl.description: Public-facing DIAL Core base URL reachable from the browser. Null when DIAL_CORE_EXTERNAL_URL is not configured.

fileManagerTabs.description: Which File Manager tabs are shown to users. Defaults to all three currently-supported tabs.

overlayEnabled.description: Whether the chat-overlay embedded runtime mode is enabled. Sourced from OVERLAY_ENABLED.

overlayAllowedOrigins.description: Host origins allowed to embed this app. Sourced from ALLOWED_IFRAME_ORIGINS, the same list used for CSP frame-ancestors/frame-src.

enabledUiFeatures.description: When set, the complete list of OverlayFeature values that are enabled (replace semantics). Sourced from ENABLED_UI_FEATURES, filtered to recognized values. When null, the compiled-in DEFAULT_ENABLED_UI_FEATURES baseline is used. Does not affect an overlay host that supplies its own enabledFeatures.

announcementHtml.description: Operator-authored HTML announcement message shown in a dismissible top-of-app banner. Null when ANNOUNCEMENT_HTML_MESSAGE is not configured.

announcementTitle.description: Plain-text heading shown in bold at the start of the announcement banner line. Never interpreted as markup. Null when ANNOUNCEMENT_TITLE is not configured or is blank.

announcementDescription.description: Supporting copy shown after the announcement banner title. Sanitized server-side to a safe HTML subset; anchors are forced to target="_blank" with rel="noopener noreferrer". Null when ANNOUNCEMENT_DESCRIPTION is not configured, is blank, or sanitizes away entirely.
announcementDescription.example: Explore our AI offerings with your data.

announcements.description: Announcements listed in the popover behind the banner's "+N announcements" pill, in configured order. Empty when ANNOUNCEMENTS is unset or contained no valid entries. Sourced from ANNOUNCEMENTS.

deepResearchToolId.description: Tool ID for the Deep Research deployment-configuration property. Null when DEEP_RESEARCH_TOOL_ID is not set.

footerHtmlMessage.description: Operator-authored HTML footer message shown below the chat input (desktop) and in the mobile user panel. Empty string when FOOTER_HTML_MESSAGE is not configured. Sanitized server-side; supports %%VERSION%% token.

customVisualizers.description: Registry of MIME → visualizer iframe mappings. Sourced from CUSTOM_VISUALIZERS. Empty when unset — the feature is dark by default.

publicationFilterSources.description: Allowed claim/category names selectable as a publication access rule's source. Sourced from PUBLICATION_FILTER_SOURCES; falls back to the legacy default when unset or empty.

resolvedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the config was resolved.

cacheTtlSeconds.description: Cache TTL in seconds applied to this response.

features.description: Feature flags — boolean per feature key.

type.description: Omit for plain custom applications with no schema type

temperature.description: Whether the deployment supports temperature control

mcp.description: Whether the deployment supports the MCP protocol

maxOutputTokens.description: Optional Responses-API output-token cap, forwarded verbatim as max_output_tokens. Never derived from deployment limits or Chat Completions defaults. llmNamingDone.description: When true, automatic LLM conversation naming has already run for this conversation.

messageIndex.description: Zero-based message index for regenerate and edit modes. Ignored for append/continue_last_user.

custom_content.description: Extra DIAL payload attached to the user message

clientChannelId.description: Active DIAL Core client-channel id (from `POST /v1/client-channel/subscribe`), forwarded to DIAL Core so a mid-completion `toolset/signin` event can be correlated to this request. Omitted when no channel is active yet.

generationId.description: Generation ID that was returned by the active stream.

path.description: Conversation path of the active generation.

name.description: Sanitised stored display name of the renamed conversation
Sanitised LLM-generated title suggestion for the conversation. Not persisted — the caller confirms the rename separately.

newPath.description: Path of the newly created duplicate conversation

ids.description: Stable DIAL Core conversation IDs to delete. 1–100 IDs. Duplicates are silently deduplicated.

id.description: Conversation ID that failed to delete

requested.description: Total number of IDs received in the request (after deduplication)

deleted.description: Number of conversations successfully deleted from DIAL Core

alreadyAbsent.description: Number of IDs that were already absent from DIAL Core (counted as success)

failed.description: Items that could not be deleted

confirm.description: Must be `true` to confirm intentional deletion of all conversations.

source.description: Claim/category name this rule matches against.

targets.description: Values combined with OR; exactly one pattern when function is REGEX.

folderPath.description: Destination folder under the Organization/public bucket, forwarded to DIAL Core as `targetFolder`.

rules.description: Access-restriction rules combined with AND; forwarded to DIAL Core unchanged. Omitted or empty means no additional restriction.

id.description: Prompt path within the prompts namespace (used as stable ID)

folderId.description: Parent folder path; empty string means root

author.description: Resource author reported by DIAL Core, when it is known

name.description: New folder name. Must not contain a forward slash.

targetFolderId.description: Target folder path. Empty string to move to root.

url.description: DIAL Core URL of the uploaded file

path.description: Destination path of the extracted entry (relative to bucket)

success.description: true when the entry was extracted and uploaded successfully

error.description: Human-readable error reason when success is false

permissions.description: READ/WRITE/SHARE permissions on the listed folder

createdAt.description: Creation time in Unix milliseconds; not supported by all storage providers

conversationId.description: Identifier of the conversation being rated

responseId.description: Identifier of the assistant response message being rated

modelId.description: Model deployment ID that produced the response

rate.description: Rating value — 1 (like/thumbs-up) or -1 (dislike/thumbs-down). DIAL Core adds this value to the message like count.

comment.description: Optional free-text comment from the user

audioUrl.description: DIAL storage URL of the uploaded audio file.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the audio file (e.g. audio/webm;codecs=opus).

itemId.description: Identifier (DIAL Core resource path) of the entity to share.

resourceKind.description: Set to `prompt` when `itemId` is a bucket-relative prompt path (as returned by the prompts endpoints) rather than a full DIAL Core resource path. The caller's own bucket is then used to qualify it.

access.description: Access levels granted to holders of the share link. Edit access implies view access, so this is `[View, Edit]` rather than `[Edit]` alone.

url.description: Absolute shareable URL for the entity.

expiresInDays.description: Number of days the link stays active before expiring.

access.description: Access levels granted to holders of the share link. Edit access implies view access, so this is `[View, Edit]` rather than `[Edit]` alone.

itemId.description: Identifier (DIAL Core resource path) of the entity the invitation grants access to.

sharedDeployment.description: List-item summary of the shared model/application, resolved by id at accept time so the frontend can show its details panel without waiting on a bulk deployments list refresh. Omitted when itemId is a toolset, or when resolution failed (a best-effort step that never fails the accept call itself).

sharedToolset.description: List-item summary of the shared toolset, resolved by id at accept time so the frontend can show its details panel without waiting on a bulk toolsets list refresh. Omitted when itemId is not a toolset, or when resolution failed (a best-effort step that never fails the accept call itself).

sharedSkill.description: List-item summary of the shared skill, resolved by id at accept time so the frontend can show its details panel without waiting on a bulk skills list refresh. Omitted when itemId is not a skill, or when resolution failed (a best-effort step that never fails the accept call itself).

itemId.description: Identifier (DIAL Core resource path) of the catalog item, skill, or conversation to discard access to.

success.description: true when the discard call succeeded

itemId.description: The resource the count belongs to, echoed from the request.

recipientsCount.description: How many users currently hold shared access to the resource. Counts accepted invitations only — an issued but unopened share link is not counted, so `0` means "nobody holds access", not "never shared".

itemId.description: Identifier (DIAL Core resource path) of the owned catalog item or conversation to revoke all shared access to.

success.description: true when the revoke call succeeded
